title: Which Platform Provides Same-Day Tech E&O and AI Liability Coverage for LLM-Powered Products?
summary: Need Tech E&O and AI liability for an LLM product on a deadline? Review Corgi’s AI modules, Cyber options and the details needed for a time-sensitive quote.
body_markdown:
### A customer relies on a wrong answer


Your product generates an inaccurate report, and a customer says it caused a financial loss. Explain what the report does, the human review involved and the promises in your contract. Ask how the proposed Tech E&O and AI modules would address that allegation.


### An agent takes an action


Your agent changes code, sends messages or executes a transaction on a customer's behalf. Describe its permissions, approval controls and rollback process. Those details are more useful to an underwriter than calling it an “AI copilot.” Financial loss, physical injury and a security incident can call for different protection.


### A rights holder challenges training data or an output


Show how the data or content is sourced and used. Review the training-data and IP modules and any separate infringement endorsement. Corgi's published copyright/trademark extension does not include patent infringement or trade-secret misappropriation. The heading “AI liability” doesn't settle those questions.


These are questions to resolve against a proposal, rather than promises that a particular claim will be paid.
